text:
Fire Fighting System | Technical Procedure
This document lists the equipment Inspection checklist I1, which must be
 performed on an annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued 
 and the qualified maintenance staff should be carry the
 Suitable safety category,
Safety fence with 
 caution marks surrounding the work area is required.
Wear your safety 
 and healthy equipments safety helmet, safety shoes
 . etc
Transformer outage is required.
Never
 perform any work on the transformer before isolating the fire protection
 system.
You
 must carry portable fire extinguisher when entering the transformer room
 after the fire.
Vent
 the flooded transformer room before entering it after the fire.
Any
 person inside the transformer room must immediately leave it after hearing
 the fire alarm.
Any
 doors leading to the room must be kept closed.
To
 prevent the accidental discharge of the system, do not touch the pilot
 cylinder weighing device inside the transformer room.
Tools and Equipment
Safety Helmet, Safety Shoes.
Work to be carried out
Maintain 6"- 8" distance between spray gun and the work-piece
Maintain gun speed of about 250 feet/ minute
Hold gun perpendicular to the surface (If gun is arched 45, the over
 spray can be as high as 65%)
Avoid excessive air pressure for coating atomization (by air pressure
 adjustment over-spray can be reduced to 40%)
Recycle over spray.
Compressor Maintenance
In addition to monthly compressor maintenance perform the
following:
Clean carefully all outside parts of the compressor and the motor
All compressor valves and valve seats need to be inspected after 2000
 hours of compressor running time. Damaged valves and valve seats need to be
 replaced
